text_simplified: The school is the second tarbiyah (upbringing) institution after the masjid, and it plays a major role in building the child socially and in akhlaq (moral character). The school helps the child learn the principles of cooperation and respect for others, and it nurtures their leadership personality. It also strengthens moral values when parents cooperate with the school in guiding the child.

review_defects.arabic: دور المدرسة في تربية الطفل اجتماعياً وأخلاقياً
review_defects.english: The Role of the School in the Child’s Social and Akhlaq-Based Tarbiyah
review_defects.why: The Arabic title says the school's role in the child's upbringing socially and morally (adverbs modifying 'upbringing'). The English title restructures this as 'Social and Akhlaq-Based Tarbiyah', implying the tarbiyah itself is based on akhlaq and is social, which shifts the meaning and introduces the term 'akhlaq' not present as a noun in the Arabic title.
